title: The Bamboo That Waited Five Years

characters.name: the farmer
characters.look: weathered middle-aged farmer, straw hat, faded blue work shirt, kind tired eyes

setting: a quiet hillside farm in early morning mist

scenes.narration: For four years, he watered a patch of dirt. Nothing grew. Not a single leaf.
scenes.image_prompt: the farmer kneeling beside a bare patch of soil holding a watering can, misty dawn, lonely wide shot

scenes.narration: His neighbors laughed. Why keep watering something that refuses to live?
scenes.image_prompt: villagers pointing and laughing from a fence while the farmer keeps watering bare soil, golden hour

scenes.narration: Still, every single morning, he came back. Same soil. Same water. Same silence.
scenes.image_prompt: close-up of weathered hands pouring water onto dark soil, droplets catching sunrise light

scenes.narration: What nobody could see was happening underground. Roots, spreading for miles, getting ready.
scenes.image_prompt: cross-section view of earth revealing a vast glowing network of bamboo roots spreading underground beneath a bare surface

card.text: Some bamboo spends years growing roots before shooting up.

scenes.narration: Then, in the fifth year, the bamboo shot up nearly ninety feet in just six weeks.
scenes.image_prompt: towering bamboo forest bursting upward toward the sky, the farmer small at the base looking up in awe, epic low angle

scenes.narration: So if you are working hard and seeing nothing, you might just be growing roots. Keep going.
scenes.image_prompt: the farmer standing proudly in a lush bamboo grove at sunrise, warm light rays, hopeful mood
